tabs.title: MAP
tabs.lead: Move the theater. Units stay put until you order them.

shots.caption: WASD pans. Hold MMB and drag for the same.
Q / E or the wheel zooms. Home recenters Penghu.
Space pauses. F1…F5 set speed. Top bar shows the same.
R or MOD R switches the radar plot. N is the map.

notes: Esc opens the pause sheet. It does not quit.
F11 is the frame profiler. F12 is debug chrome.

tabs.title: UNITS
tabs.lead: Select, then point. The planner stays on land, water, or air.

shots.caption: LMB picks a unit. Shift+drag boxes a group.
RMB sends the selection. Land will not walk into the sea.
Shift+RMB adds a sea or air waypoint instead of replacing the route.
Halt from the order sheet, or give a new RMB.

notes: One click on empty ground clears the selection.
A port, ferry, or bridge selected alone opens its local commands.

tabs.title: SIGHT
tabs.lead: You see what sensors report. China does the same.

shots.caption: Unseen ground stays dark. Contacts fade when the track dies.
VISION toggles rings. RANGE is weapons. UNITS hides kinds on the map.

notes: The CONTACTS stack is the same feed as the chat on the left.
Satellite windows are on the top bar as SAT.

tabs.title: PORTS
tabs.lead: Ferries move land units. A port holds a small pool of hulls.

shots.caption: Launch, then click water. The hull leaves that port.
Load a land unit, then unload on another shore.

notes: Recall brings an empty ferry home. Destroy is only for a selected bridge.

tabs.title: FIRE
tabs.lead: Doctrine and magazines sit on the selected battery.

shots.caption: FIRE / HOLD / filters. Artillery can aim a point on the map.
Magazine / reserve on the tooltip. RLD is a clip change.

notes: Idle units mend over two calendar days. Spare rounds do not come back.

tabs.title: HOLD
tabs.lead: There is no final win. Hold the inhabited islands as long as you can.

shots.caption: An island flips when the last player ground unit leaves it.

notes: Air does not hold ground. China wins when no player land unit remains on any island.
You may leave to the menu at any time from pause.
